# models.fit_scage_reference { #falconage.models.fit_scage_reference }

```python
models.fit_scage_reference(
    data,
    *,
    age_col='age',
    min_abs_r=0.2,
    max_sites=30000,
)
```

Fit the per-CpG age models on a bulk reference cohort.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                     | Default   |
|-----------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| min_abs_r | float  | Keep only sites whose absolute correlation with age clears this. Including every site drowns the signal in slopes that are noise.                                               | `0.2`     |
| max_sites | int    | Cap, applied after ranking by ``\|r\|``. Thirty thousand informative sites is far more than any single cell will cover, and the likelihood is a sum over the covered ones only. | `30000`   |
